name: pstack-resident
description: Opt-in resident mode for pstack-zcode: a SessionStart hook that injects the condensed poteto-mode summary into sessions where poteto-mode is reachable — a project-level install in the tree, or a global install under the home directory. Installing this plugin is the whole opt-in; sessions that cannot reach poteto-mode get nothing.

description_i18n.zh-CN: pstack-zcode 的常驻模式（可选）：SessionStart 钩子向 poteto-mode 可达的会话（项目级安装或家目录下的全局安装）注入精简纪律摘要。安装本插件即完成 opt-in；poteto-mode 不可达的会话零注入。
